summary: Intelligent Bio Solutions Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 9, 2026, furnishing a press release under Items 7.01 and 8.01 announcing submission of a 510(k) premarket notification to the FDA. The filing seeks U.S. regulatory clearance of the company's Intelligent Fingerprinting Drug Screening System for detection of the opiate codeine. The submission includes a Method Comparison Study reporting accuracy above 98%, sensitivity above 94%, and 100% specificity across three independent U.S. clinical sites. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situations mechanics are stated; this is a routine regulatory/product milestone disclosure, not a special situation.
